blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation supports multi-hop retrieval by organizing corpus information into graphs. However, existing relation-free graph retrieval methods rely primarily on query–sentence similarity to search for evidence. This can exclude useful bridging evidence with low query similarity and activate incidental entities unrelated to the reasoning chain. In this paper, we propose a simple and effective approach called NexusRAG, which augments the relation-free Tri-Graph with a corpus-level entity neighborhood structure derived from joint entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. NexusRAG employs this structure to guide two complementary propagation paths: neighborhood-constrained semantic propagation through sentences identifies the query-relevant entity frontier, while direct structural propagation between neighboring entities expands that frontier to structurally related entities. The propagated entity weights also inform neighborhood-aware passage initialization for Personalized PageRank. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench show that NexusRAG consistently outperforms existing approaches. On the GraphRAG-Bench subset, NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all question categories, exceeding baselines by 4.2–8.1 points.
blocks.zh: 基于图的检索增强生成支持多跳的检索,方法是将实体信息组织成图. 然而,现有的无关系的图检索方法主要依靠查询-判决与寻找证据的相似性。 这可以排除与低查询相似的有用的连接证据,并激活与推理链无关的附带实体. 在本文中,我们提出了一个名为NexusRAG的简单而有效的方法,它用从联合实体共同发生和语义相似性衍生出来的实体级实体邻里结构来增强无关系的Tri-Graph. NexusRAG使用这一结构来指导两个互补的传播途径:通过句子来识别与查询相关的实体边界,而邻近实体之间的直接结构传播则将这一边界扩展到与结构相关的实体。 宣传的实体权重也为个人化的PageRank提供了解街区的初始化信息。 对3个多跳QA基准和GraphRAG-Bench特定域子集的实验显示,NexusRAG的绩效始终高于现有方法. 在GraphRAG-Bench子集上,NexusRAG在所有问题类别中实现最高的证据召回,超过基线4.2-8.1点。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to ground their responses in external evidence ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) . Conventional RAG systems typically retrieve passages based on their semantic similarity to the query. Although effective in finding directly relevant information, this approach can struggle with questions that require connecting evidence across multiple documents. In such cases, necessary intermediate evidence may have a low similarity to the original query, with its relevance becoming apparent only through connections to other passages. Independent passage retrieval can therefore overlook useful bridging evidence, leaving the generator without sufficient information to answer the question ( Borgeaud et al., 2022 ; Izacard et al., 2023 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 检索增强的生成(RAG)使得大型语言模型(LLMs)能够在外部证据中进行其答复(Lewis等人,2020年;Gao等人,2023年)。 常规 RAG系统一般根据其语义与查询的相似性检索段落. 虽然这种方法在寻找直接相关信息方面是有效的,但可能会遇到需要通过多种文件将证据联系起来的问题。 在这种情况下,必要的中间证据可能与原始查询的相似性较低,其相关性只有通过与其他段落的连接才变得明显. 因此,独立通道检索可以忽略有用的连接证据,使生成者没有足够的信息来回答问题(Borgeaud等人,2022年;Izacard等人,2023年;Han等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) addresses this limitation by explicitly modeling connections within a corpus to guide evidence retrieval ( Edge et al., 2024 ; Procko and Ochoa, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Related approaches explore different forms of structural organization. RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) recursively clusters and summarizes text to build a hierarchical index, while Microsoft GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2024 ) constructs an entity graph and generates summaries of its communities. Other methods exploit explicit entity–relation graphs to support retrieval and reasoning ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . These structures help connect evidence across documents, allowing retrieval to account for relationships that independent passage scoring may overlook.
blocks.zh: 基于图表的检索增强生成(GraphRAG)解决了这一局限性,在一项文书中明确建模连接,以指导证据的检索(Edge等人,2024年;Procko和Ochoa,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年)。 相关方法探索不同形式的结构组织. RAPTOR(Sarthi等人,2024年)递归集群并总结文本以构建分级索引,而Microsoft GraphRAG(Edge等人,2024年)则构建实体图并生成其社区摘要. 其他方法利用明确实体-关系图支持检索和推理(Gutiérrez等人,2024年;Gutiérrez等人,2025年;Guo等人,2025年;He等人,2024年;Luo等人,2025年)。 这些结构有助于将各种文件的证据联系起来,使检索能够说明独立段落评分可能忽略的关系。

blocks.en: However, graph construction introduces its own sources of error. Inaccurate relation extraction can create misleading links between entities, while fragmented or inconsistent graph structures can hinder access to relevant evidence. Such errors can degrade the retrieved context and compromise downstream reasoning. GraphRAG-Bench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) evaluates graph construction, retrieval, and generation across four levels of task complexity: fact retrieval, complex reasoning, contextual summarization, and creative generation. In particular, its evidence recall metric measures the proportion of reference claims supported by the retrieved context, independently of the generated answer. This distinction highlights the importance of recovering complete supporting evidence when questions require integrating information across multiple passages.
blocks.zh: 然而,图表构造引入了自己的错误来源. 不准确的关系提取可能会在实体之间产生误导性的联系,而零碎或不一致的图表结构则会阻碍获取相关证据. 此类错误会降低检索的上下文,损害下游推理. GraphRAG-Bench(Xiang et al., 2026)评价图的构建,检索,生成等四个层次的任务复杂度:事实检索,复杂的推理,背景归纳,创造性生成. 特别是,它的证据回顾衡量了被检索的上下文所支持的参考索赔的比例,而不考虑得到的答复。 这种区分突出了在问题需要将信息综合到多个段落时收回完整的佐证证据的重要性。

blocks.en: These limitations motivate relation-free graph retrieval, which builds a useful corpus structure without explicitly extracting semantic relations between entities. LinearRAG ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , for example, constructs an entity-sentence-passage Tri-Graph using lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking. Starting from entities matched to the query, it iteratively propagates activation through the entity-sentence subgraph, guided by query-sentence similarity. The resulting entity scores, together with query-passage relevance, initialize Personalized PageRank (PPR) ( Haveliwala, 2002 ) on the entity-passage subgraph to rank passages. Corpus sentences thus serve as contextual bridges between entities, supporting multi-hop retrieval without explicit relation extraction.
blocks.zh: 这些限制刺激了无关系图检索,它构建了实用的函体结构,而没有明确提取实体之间的语义关系. 例如,线性RAG(Zhuang等人,2026年)利用轻量级实体提取和语义连接构建了实体-判决-通过Tri-Graph. 从与查询匹配的实体开始,它以查询-判决相似性为指导,通过实体-判决子图反复宣传激活. 由此而来的实体分数加上查询-通过相关性,在实体-通过子图上初始化个人化的PageRank(PPR)(Haveliwala,2002年),以排列段落. 因此,Corpus句子充当实体之间的上下文桥梁,支持多跳检索,而无需明确关系提取.

blocks.en: However, LinearRAG’s sentence-mediated propagation ties entity activation to query-sentence similarity, which can lead to two failure modes. Query-gated cutoff occurs when a sentence connecting relevant entities has low query similarity, weakening the activation signal and potentially preventing propagation from reaching necessary evidence. Spurious activation occurs when a query-relevant sentence mentions incidental entities, allowing activation to spread to entities that do not support the answer. Together, these cases highlight a limitation of using sentence relevance to guide entity transitions: a useful bridge may have low query similarity, while a relevant sentence may contain irrelevant entities. This motivates complementing query-dependent sentence mediation with an explicit corpus-level entity neighborhood to guide propagation.
blocks.zh: 然而,LinearRAG的句子介导传播关系实体激活到查询-判决相似,这可能导致两种失败模式。 当连接相关实体的句子具有低查询相似性,削弱激活信号,并可能阻止传播达到必要的证据时,就会出现查询加码截断. 当一个与查询相关的句子提到附带实体时,就会发生纯粹的激活,允许激活扩散到不支持答案的实体. 这些案例加在一起突出了使用句子相关性来指导实体过渡的局限性:一个有用的桥可能具有低查询相似性,而相关的句子可能包含不相关的实体. 这激励人们用明确的实体级社区来补充依赖查询的判刑调解,以指导传播。

blocks.en: We propose NexusRAG, a corpus-guided graph retrieval framework that augments the relation-free Tri-Graph with a corpus-level neighbor prior derived from entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. This prior captures entity relatedness without explicit relation extraction and guides a dual-path propagation process. The semantic propagation uses query-sentence similarity to identify a relevant entity frontier, with entity transitions constrained by the neighbor prior. The structural propagation then expands this frontier through structurally related entities. The resulting entity weights inform passage initialization for Personalized PageRank, incorporating neighborhood information into passage ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们提出NexusRAG,这是一个由实体指导的图检索框架,它可以与一个实体级的邻邻邻扩大无关联的Tri-Graph,其前因实体共聚和语义相似而产生。 这种事先捕捉实体关联性而不明确关联提取,并指导双路径传播过程。 语义传播利用查询判决的相似性来确定相关的实体边界,实体过渡事先受到邻居的限制。 然后通过结构相关实体扩大这一前沿。 由此产生的实体权重为个人化PageRank的通过初始化提供信息,将邻里信息纳入通过排名。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We identify two failure modes of sentence-mediated entity propagation, query-gated cutoff and spurious activation , highlighting the limitations of query–sentence relevance as a guide for entity transitions. • We propose NexusRAG, a simple and effective approach which uses a corpus-level neighbor prior to guide dual-path propagation, recovering bridging evidence while suppressing spurious entity activation without explicit relation extraction. • Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements over multiple strong baselines. NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all four categories of the GraphRAG-Bench subset, exceeding baselines by 4.2–8.1 points.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们确定了两种以句子为媒介的实体传播、查询截止和虚假激活的失败模式,突出了查询-判决相关性作为实体过渡指南的局限性。 我们建议NexusRAG是一种简单有效的方法,在引导双向传播之前先使用一个实体级的邻居,收回过渡性证据,同时在没有明确关系提取的情况下压制虚假实体的激活。 · 对三个多跳QA基准和GraphRAG-Bench特定域子集的试验显示,在多个强基线方面,有持续改进。 NexusRAG在GraphRAG-Bench子集的所有四个类别中都实现了最高的证据召回,超过基线4.2-8.1分.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language models on retrieved external evidence ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) . Dense passage retrieval is effective when relevant information is localized, but questions that require evidence from multiple documents motivate retrieval methods that explicitly organize or reason over corpus structure.
blocks.zh: 检索-增强的一代(RAG)将语言模型基于检索的外部证据(Lewis等人,2020年;Karpukhin等人,2020年;Gao等人,2023年)。 当相关信息被本地化时,深思熟虑的通道检索是有效的,但需要多份文件提供证据的问题促使检索方法明确安排或解释过份实体结构。

blocks.en:
Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) introduces relational structure to support multi-hop retrieval. We focus on three graph construction strategies that are most relevant to this work.
One line of work organizes corpus information into hierarchical structures using clustering, community detection, or recursive summarization. Microsoft GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2024 ) identifies communities in an entity graph and generates summaries at multiple levels, while RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) recursively clusters and summarizes text to construct a hierarchical representation. E2GraphRAG ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) also uses hierarchical representations to support multi-hop retrieval. These methods provide access to corpus information at different levels of abstraction, but their performance depends on the intermediate grouping or summary structures.
Another line of work constructs explicit knowledge graphs by extracting entities and relations from text. HippoRAG ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) and HippoRAG2 ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) build knowledge graphs from extracted relations and apply Personalized PageRank for retrieval. LightRAG ( Guo et al., 2025 ) combines entity–relation structures with hierarchical representations, while G-Retriever ( He et al., 2024 ) and GFM-RAG ( Luo et al., 2025 ) perform graph-based retrieval over structured textual knowledge. These approaches make relational information explicit, but relation extraction introduces additional indexing cost and can produce noisy or inconsistent relations.
blocks.zh:
基于图的检索-增强生成(GraphRAG)引入了关系结构以支持多跳检索. 我们侧重于与这项工作最相关的三个图表建设战略。
一项工作是利用集群、社区检测或递归式汇总,将实体信息组织成分级结构。 Microsoft GraphRAG(Edge等人,2024年)在一个实体图中确定社区并生成多个层次的摘要,而RAPTOR(Sarthi等人,2024年)则递归集群并总结文本以构建分级代表. E2GraphRAG(赵等人,2025年)也使用分级表示支持多跳检索. 这些方法在不同抽象层次上提供了对实体信息的获取,但其性能取决于中间分组或总结结构.
另一行工作通过从文本中提取实体和关系来构建明确的知识图. 希波拉格语Name (Gutiérrez等人,2024年)和HippoRAG2(Gutiérrez等人,2025年)从提取的关系建立知识图,并应用个性化的PageRank进行检索. LightRAG(Guo et al.,2025年)将实体-关系结构与等级代表相结合,而G-Retriever(He et al.,2024年)和GFM-RAG(Luo et al.,2025年)则在结构化的文字知识上进行图表检索. 这些方法使关系信息变得明确,但关系提取带来了额外的索引费用,并可能产生吵闹或不一致的关系.

blocks.en: Relation-free Graph Retrieval avoids explicit relation extraction and derive graph structure directly from corpus observations. LinearRAG ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) constructs an entity–sentence–passage Tri-Graph using lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking. Its retrieval process activates entities through query-relevant sentences and aggregates passage importance with Personalized PageRank. NexusRAG retains this relation-free graph construction and introduces corpus-level neighbor weights computed from entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. The same weights are used during entity propagation and passage initialization, providing a structural signal throughout retrieval.
blocks.zh: 无关系图检索避免了显性关系提取,直接从实体观测中得出图结构. LinearRAG(Zhuang等人,2026年)利用轻量级实体提取和语义连接,构建了一个实体–sentence–passage Tri-Graph. 它的检索程序通过查询相关的句子激活实体,并用个性化的PageRank来汇总通过的重要性. NexusRAG保留了这种无关系图构造,并引入了从实体共发生和语义相似性计算出来的实体级邻重. 在实体传播和通过初始化过程中也使用同样的权重,在整个检索过程中提供结构信号。

blocks.en: Reasoning-enhanced RAG uses language models to decompose or refine complex queries rather than explicitly organizing the corpus into a graph. LogicRAG ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and LAG ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) decompose questions into subqueries with logical dependencies, while Chain-of-Note ( Yu et al., 2024 ) generates intermediate notes before retrieving supporting documents. Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2024 ) incorporates self-reflection into the retrieval-generation process. These approaches use query-side reasoning to retrieve evidence for multi-step questions, whereas NexusRAG uses corpus-side structural information for graph retrieval.
blocks.zh: 理由增强 RAG使用语言模型来分解或完善复杂的查询,而不是明确地将本体组织成一个图表. LogicRAG(Chen等人,2026年)和LAG(Shao等人,2025年)将问题分解成带有逻辑依赖性的子库,而Chain-of-Note(Yu等人,2024年)在检索证明文件之前生成中间音符. Self-RAG(Asai等人,2024年)将自我反射纳入检索生成过程。 这些方法利用查询-侧推理为多步骤问题取回证据,而NexusRAG则使用实体-侧结构信息进行图表检索.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of NexusRAG. 1) Graph Construction. The corpus is indexed into a relation-free entity–sentence–passage Tri-Graph. 2) Neighbor Prior. A sparse corpus-level entity neighbor matrix 𝐖 \mathbf{W} is constructed from co-occurrence and semantic similarity with rank and weight pruning. 3) Entity Propagation. Given a query q q , neighbor-constrained semantic propagation identifies a query-relevant entity frontier, which structural propagation expands through 𝐖 \mathbf{W} to obtain the activated entity set. 4) Passage Retrieval. Cumulative entity weights and neighbor-aware passage weights initialize Personalized PageRank for top- K K passage retrieval.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Overview. NexusRAG follows the relation-free GraphRAG paradigm established by LinearRAG ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , where entities serve as anchors for connecting evidence distributed across passages. The corpus is indexed as an entity–sentence–passage Tri-Graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , with entity nodes ℰ \mathcal{E} , sentence nodes 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , and passage nodes 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . Edges connect entities to the sentences and passages in which they appear, preserving contextual evidence within the original corpus structure.
blocks.zh: 概览. NexusRAG遵循了LinearRAG(Zhuang等人,2026年)确立的无关系GraphRAG范式,其中实体充当连接跨段落分布的证据的锚. 主体索引为实体 – 判决 – 通过 Tri-Graph G\mathcal{G}, 实体节点 E\mathcal{E}, 句子节点 S\mathcal{S}, 和通过节点 P\mathcal{P} 。 边缘将实体与它们出现时的句子和段落联系起来,在原物状结构中保留了背景证据.

blocks.en: Retrieval proceeds in two stages: 1) entity activation, where query-related entities are activated and propagated through the entity–sentence subgraph to identify intermediate evidence, with each active entity selecting its top- η \eta query-similar sentences and propagating activation to other entities in those sentences with scores proportional to the source activation and query–sentence similarity; 2) passage retrieval, where the activated entity evidence is transferred to the entity–passage subgraph to initialize Personalized PageRank, which ranks the top- K K passages for the LLM.
blocks.zh: 回收收益分两个阶段: 1) 实体激活,通过实体-判决子图激活和传播与查询相关的实体,以识别中间证据,每个活动实体选择其顶端-\\eta查询-类似句子,并在这些句子中向其他实体宣传激活,其分数与源激活和查询-判决相似;2) 通道检索,将激活的实体证据转移到实体-通过子图启动个人化的PageRank,将LLM的顶端-K K通道排序.

blocks.en: This workflow places entity propagation at the center of multi-hop retrieval: the quality of the activated entities directly affects the evidence passed to passage initialization and subsequent PageRank ranking. We therefore revisit how query-dependent propagation determines entity importance and identify two failure modes: query-gated cutoff and spurious activation .
blocks.zh: 这个工作流程将实体传播置于多跳检索的中心:激活实体的质量直接影响传递到通过初始化和之后的PageRank排名的证据. 因此,我们重新审视依赖查询的传播如何决定实体的重要性,并确定两种失败模式:查询中断和虚假激活。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce NexusRAG with a query-independent neighbor prior that complements query-dependent sentence relevance with corpus-level entity structure. Figure 1 illustrates the overall framework. The neighbor prior supports a dual-path propagation process: the semantic propagation uses entity-level structural evidence to constrain transitions within query-relevant sentences, while the structural propagation expands activated entities through structurally related neighbors when sentence mediation is insufficient. The resulting entity evidence is then used for passage initialization and Personalized PageRank, providing a more reliable basis for multi-hop passage retrieval.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了NexusRAG,其前身是一个独立的查询邻居,以实体级的实体结构补充依赖查询的句子。 图1说明了总体框架。 邻居先前支持双路径传播过程:语义传播使用实体层面的结构证据来约束与查询相关的句子中的过渡,而结构传播则在句子调解不足时通过结构相关邻居扩展激活的实体. 由此产生的实体证据随后用于通道初始化和个性化PageRank,为多跳通道检索提供了更可靠的依据.

blocks.en: 3.1 Evidence Retrieval Failures in LinearRAG
blocks.zh: 3.1 在线性RAG中获取证据失败

blocks.en: Multi-hop retrieval requires recovering intermediate evidence that connects successive reasoning steps. Results from GraphRAG-Bench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) reveal a less intuitive pattern: higher evidence recall does not necessarily lead to higher context relevance. With the passage retrieval budget fixed at K = 5 K=5 , one would expect retrieving more gold evidence to improve relevance if query relevance were sufficient to identify useful evidence. The observed mismatch suggests that evidence required for multi-hop reasoning is not always aligned with the query relevance used to guide retrieval.
blocks.zh: 多跳检索需要恢复连接连续推理步骤的中间证据. GraphRAG-Bench(Xiang等人,2026年)的结果表明,直觉性较弱:较高的证据召回并不一定会导致更高的上下文相关性. 随着通道检索预算定在K=5K=5,如果查询相关性足以确定有用的证据,人们会期望收回更多的黄金证据,以提高相关性。 观察到的不匹配表明,多跳推理所需的证据并不总是与用于指导检索的查询相关性相一致.

blocks.en: We therefore examine LinearRAG, where entity propagation is mediated by query–sentence relevance. With GPT-4o-mini as the answer generator, LinearRAG achieves accuracies of 38.2 % 38.2\% , 69.5 % 69.5\% , 65.0 % 65.0\% , and 65.32 % 65.32\% on MuSiQue, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and the Medical subset of GraphRAG-Bench, respectively. Among its incorrect answers, 98.4 % 98.4\% , 82.3 % 82.3\% , 75.1 % 75.1\% , and 99.6 % 99.6\% are classified as retrieval misses, respectively (Figure 2 (a)). This indicates that incomplete retrieval is a major source of failure and motivates examining how entity activation is propagated before passage ranking.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们审查LinearRAG,其中实体传播是通过询问-判决的关联性进行调解的。 以GPT-4o-mini为解答生成器,线性RAG分别实现38.2% 38.2\%,69.5% 69.5\%,65.0% 65.0\%,65.32% 65.32\%在MuSiQue, HotpotQA, 2Wiki MultiHopQA,以及GraphRAG-Bench的医学子集. 其错误的答案中,98.4%为98.4%,82.3%为82.3%,75.1%为75.1%,99.6%为99.6%为检索缺失(图2(a))。 这表明,不完全的检索是失败的一个主要原因,并促使人们审查实体激活是如何在通过排名之前传播的。

blocks.en: To locate the source of these retrieval misses, we further inspect the role of bridge evidence in the propagation process. For HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and Medical, we distinguish cases where the bridge entity is not retrieved from those where the bridge entity is retrieved but the answer passage is missing. The two cases account for 16.1 % 16.1\% and 66.2 % 66.2\% of incorrect answers on HotpotQA, 27.4 % 27.4\% and 47.7 % 47.7\% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and 82.5 % 82.5\% and 17.1 % 17.1\% on Medical, respectively. These results show that retrieval failures are not limited to the final answer passage: in many cases, the intermediate bridge entity itself fails to receive sufficient activation for subsequent expansion.
blocks.zh: 为了找到这些检索缺失的来源,我们进一步检查桥梁证据在传播过程中的作用。 对于HotpotQA,2Wiki MultiHopQA,和Medical,我们区分了桥实体未被检索的情况与桥实体被检索但答案通道缺失的情况. 这两起案件分别占热点QA错误答案的16.1%、66.2%、27.4%和47.7%。 这些结果显示,检索失败并不限于最后的解答段落:在许多情况下,中间桥实体本身没有得到足够的激活,无法进行后续扩展.

blocks.en: We then examine LinearRAG’s query-dependent sentence mediation (Figure 2 (b)) and identify two limitations.
blocks.zh: 我们接着审查LinearRAG的基于查询的判刑调解(图2(b)),并找出两个局限性。

blocks.en: Query-gated cutoff. LinearRAG uses query–sentence similarity to control sentence-mediated propagation. However, a sentence that contains necessary bridge evidence may be only indirectly related to the query and therefore receive a low similarity score. Its contribution can then fall below the pruning threshold before the bridge entity is sufficiently activated for further propagation. This indicates that query relevance at the sentence level does not necessarily reflect the importance of the evidence carried by that sentence.
blocks.zh: 腾讯财经截断. LinearRAG 使用查询 - 判决的相似性来控制以判决为媒介的传播。 然而,包含必要桥梁证据的句子可能只与查询有间接关系,因此获得较低的相似性分数. 然后,在充分启动该桥梁实体以进一步推广之前,其贡献可能低于碾磨阈值。 这表明,在句子层面的查询相关性并不一定反映该句所携带的证据的重要性.

blocks.en: Spurious activation. The opposite problem can also occur for highly query-relevant sentences. A single sentence may contain several entities, but these entities can play very different roles in the underlying evidence chain. Because sentence-mediated propagation derives their activation from the same query–sentence relevance, entities that are incidental to the reasoning chain can receive propagation mass together with the relevant entity. This indicates that sentence-level relevance alone cannot distinguish which entities within a relevant sentence should receive stronger propagation.
blocks.zh: 纯洁的激活。 对高度查询相关的句子,也可能出现相反的问题. 单句可能包含多个实体,但这些实体在基础证据链中可以发挥非常不同的作用. 由于以句子为媒介的传播源于同样的查询-判决相关性,因此推理链附带的实体可以与相关实体一起获得传播质量。 这表明,单是判决一级的关联性无法区分在相关判决中哪些实体应得到更强有力的宣传。

blocks.en: Together, these observations show that query–sentence relevance alone is insufficient to govern entity propagation: it can both suppress necessary bridge evidence and over-activate incidental entities.
blocks.zh: 这些意见加在一起表明,单是询问-判决的相关性不足以指导实体的传播:它既可以压制必要的桥梁证据,也可以压制过度活动的附带实体。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dual-Path Entity Propagation via Neighbor Prior
blocks.zh: 3.2 通过邻里传播双帕实体

blocks.en: To address these limitations, NexusRAG introduces a query-independent neighbor prior that captures corpus-level structural relatedness between entities. We incorporate this prior into two complementary propagation paths: the semantic propagation uses it to constrain entity transitions while retaining query relevance, and the structural propagation uses it to expand query-conditioned entities through structurally related neighbors.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,NexusRAG引入了一个独立的查询邻居,在实体之间捕捉到实体层次的结构关联性。 我们先将此纳入两个互补的传播路径:语义传播利用它来限制实体的过渡,同时保留查询的相关性;结构传播利用它来通过结构上相联的邻居来扩大查询条件的实体。

blocks.en: We construct a query-independent neighbor prior from two complementary signals: sentence-level co-occurrence and semantic similarity between entity embeddings. Co-occurrence captures structural relatedness in the corpus: if two entities frequently appear in the same sentences, they are more likely to participate in the same local evidence or reasoning context. Semantic similarity links related entities in the embedding space, even when they rarely co-occur in the corpus.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个互补信号之前构建一个独立的查询邻居:句子级共振和实体嵌入之间的语义相似性. 共同发生的现象捕捉到本体中的结构关联性:如果两个实体经常出现在同一个句子中,它们更有可能参与同一个本地证据或推理背景. 语义上的相似性将嵌入空间中的相关实体联系起来,即使它们很少在实体中共同存在.

blocks.en:
We organize our experiments around three research questions: Q1 (Effectiveness): How does NexusRAG compare with the evaluated baselines in evidence recall and QA performance? Q2 (Component Analysis): How do the corpus-level neighbor prior, dual-path propagation, and neighbor-aware passage initialization contribute to performance? Q3 (Sensitivity): How do the fusion coefficient α \alpha , pruning threshold τ \tau , and neighbor cap κ \kappa affect the calculation of neighbor prior?
Additional experiments on recall evaluation, efficiency and scalability, detailed sensitivity analyses, and case studies are provided in the appendix.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate NexusRAG on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue) and the Medical subset of GraphRAG-Bench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) . For the three multi-hop benchmarks, we adopt the 1,000-question validation subsets used by LinearRAG and HippoRAG ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) . For Medical, we evaluate 2,062 questions following the GraphRAG-Bench evaluation protocol.

blocks.en: Metrics. Following Zhuang et al. (2026) , we evaluate QA performance using two metrics. Contain-Match Accuracy (Contain-Acc.) measures the proportion of generated responses containing the reference answer. LLM-as-a-Judge Accuracy (LLM-Acc.) evaluates answer correctness against the reference, allowing for valid paraphrases and formatting differences. We report both metrics on the three multi-hop QA benchmarks and only LLM-Acc. on Medical, whose reference answers are typically long and descriptive. For retrieval quality, we adopt Context Relevance and Evidence Recall from GraphRAG-Bench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) . Context Relevance assesses the alignment between the retrieved context and the question, while Evidence Recall measures the proportion of reference claims supported by the retrieved context. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose NexusRAG, a relation-free graph retrieval framework guided by a corpus-level neighbor prior derived from entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. The prior guides dual-path entity propagation and passage initialization for Personalized PageRank to mitigate query-gated cutoff and spurious activation. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench show that NexusRAG consistently outperforms the evaluated baselines across retrieval paradigms. On the GraphRAG-Bench subset, NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all four question categories, exceeding the next-best result in each category by 4.2–8.1 points.
blocks.zh: 我们提出NexusRAG,这是一个无关系图检索框架,由一个实体级的邻接者指导,先从实体共发生和语义相似性中得出。 以往指南为个人化的PageRank提供双路径实体传播和通道初始化,以减少查询中断和虚假激活。 对三个多跳QA基准和一个特定域子集GraphRAG-Bench的实验表明,NexusRAG在整个检索范式中一贯超过评估的基线。 在GraphRAG-Bench子集上,NexusRAG在所有四个问题类别中都取得了最高的证据召回,超过每个类别的次最佳结果4.2-8.1分.

A.2 Why Neighbors and Why Two Paths?
blocks.zh: A.2 为什么是邻居和为什么是两条道路?

blocks.en: The neighbor prior addresses the two failure modes and also affects answer localization. • Query-gated cutoff. When the query is lexically distant from bridging sentences, the semantic propagation alone would assign minimal scores (capped at δ \delta ), so genuine but weakly query-similar bridges are passed over. The structural propagation provides a fallback path through structural neighbors, ensuring that high-co-occurrence entities are not discarded due to surface-form mismatch. • Spurious activation. Without a structural prior, a query-similar sentence can activate multiple co-occurring entities, including entities that are not on the relevant reasoning path. The neighbor clamp in Eq. 2 bounds the transition by w i ​ j w_{ij} ; non-neighbor transitions that pass the δ \delta threshold receive the lower bound δ \delta , after which they cannot participate in the next propagation. • Answer localization. blocks.en: Why operate on semantic activations? Propagating from entities with nonzero a ~ ( t ) \tilde{a}^{(t)} focuses structural expansion on entities newly activated by semantic propagation, allowing structural propagation to recover related entities that the semantic propagation may miss. This preserves query relevance from the semantic propagation while using the neighbor structure as a complementary expansion signal.
blocks.zh: 为什么在语义激活上操作? 从非零 a ~ (t)\tilde{a}^{(t)}的实体进行传播,将结构扩展重点放在语义传播新激活的实体上,使结构传播能够恢复语义传播可能错过的相关实体。 这保留了从语义传播中查询关联性,同时将邻居结构作为互补的扩展信号.

blocks.en: Why two paths? The semantic and structural propagations address two aspects of retrieval: the semantic propagation retains query-dependent sentence mediation while the neighbor weights limit transitions through structurally weak pairs (Section 3.2 ); the structural propagation adds transitions along pre-computed neighbor edges without using sentence–query similarity. The structural propagation is seeded by semantic activation (Eq. 3 ), so it extends the frontier reached by sentence mediation rather than introducing an independent source of query entities. Together, the two paths suppress query-gated cutoff and spurious activation.
blocks.zh: 为什么只有两条路? 语义传播和结构传播涉及检索的两个方面:语义传播保留了依赖查询的句子调解,而邻居的权重则通过结构薄弱的对子限制过渡(第3.2节);结构传播增加了沿预先计算过的邻居边缘的过渡,而没有使用句子-query相似性。 结构传播以语义活化(Eq. 3)为种子,因此它扩大了通过句子调解达到的前沿,而不是引入独立的查询实体来源. 两条路径一起压制了查询的中断和虚假的激活.

blocks.en: Appendix B Datasets
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集

blocks.en: Our experimental evaluation is conducted on four datasets: three established multi-hop QA benchmarks, HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultiHopQA (2Wiki) ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , and MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) , plus one domain-specific Medical set from GraphRAG-Bench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验评价是在四个数据集上进行的:三个既定的多跳QA基准,HotpotQA(杨等人,2018年),2Wiki MultiHopQA(2Wiki)(Ho等人,2020年),和MuSiQue(Trivedi等人,2022年),加上一个来自GraphRAG-Bench(Xiang等人,2026年)的专有域的医学集.

blocks.en: (i) HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) : A benchmark comprising 97 k k question-answer instances designed to evaluate multi-hop reasoning capabilities. Each question requires models to synthesize information from multiple documents, with up to 2 gold-standard supporting passages provided alongside numerous irrelevant documents.
blocks.zh: (一)热点QA(杨等人,2018年) : 由97kk个问答实例组成的基准,旨在评价多跳推理能力. 每个问题都需要模型从多个文件中综合信息,最多提供2个黄金标准辅助段落,同时提供众多无关文件.

blocks.en: (ii) 2WikiMultiHopQA (2Wiki) ( Ho et al., 2020 ) : A multi-hop reasoning benchmark containing 192 k k questions that necessitate information integration across multiple Wikipedia articles. Each instance requires evidence synthesis from either 2 or 4 specific articles, testing models’ ability to perform structured cross-document reasoning and maintain coherent information flow.
blocks.zh: (二)2Wiki MultiHopQA(2Wiki)(Ho等人,2020年) : 多跳推理基准包含192 k个问题,需要跨维基百科多个文章的信息集成. 每个实例都需要从2或4个具体文章中综合证据,测试模型进行结构化跨文件推理的能力,并保持连贯的信息流动。

blocks.en: (iii) MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) : A multi-hop QA benchmark featuring 25 k k question-answer pairs that demand 2-4 sequential reasoning steps. Each question requires coherent multi-step logical inference across multiple documents.
blocks.zh: (三) MuSiQue(Trivedi等人,2022年): 多跳QA基准,包含25kk个问答对,需要2-4个顺序推理步骤. 每个问题都需要对多个文件进行连贯的多步骤逻辑推论。

blocks.en: (iv) Medical: A specialized subset derived from GraphRAG-Bench ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , constructed from structured clinical data sourced from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines. These guidelines provide standardized treatment protocols, drug interaction hierarchies, and diagnostic criteria. The dataset encompasses four tasks of increasing complexity: fact retrieval, complex reasoning, contextual summarization, and creative generation. GraphRAG-Bench spans 4,076 questions across these difficulty levels in total; the Medical subset used in our evaluation comprises 2,062 questions.
blocks.zh: (四) 医疗: 源自GraphRAG-Bench(Xiang等人,2026年)的一个专门子集,根据国家综合癌症网络准则提供的结构化临床数据构建。 这些准则规定了标准化的治疗规程、药物相互作用等级和诊断标准。 数据集包括四项日益复杂的任务:事实检索、复杂的推理、背景归纳和创造性生成。 GraphRAG-Bench总共涉及4 076个难题,我们评价中使用的医学子集包括2 062个问题。

blocks.en: We compare NexusRAG against the same set of retrieval and GraphRAG baselines as LinearRAG ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , plus LinearRAG itself as the direct baseline.

blocks.en: (i) Vanilla RAG retrieves the top- K K passages by dense similarity and feeds them directly to the generator, providing a retrieval-augmented lower bound without any graph structure.
blocks.zh: (一) 香草RAG通过密集的相似性将顶端-K K通道取回,并直接提供给生成器,提供无任何图结构的检索加固的下限.

blocks.en: (ii) KGP ( Wang et al., 2024 ) builds a knowledge graph over multiple passages, with edges encoding their semantic and lexical similarity; at retrieval, it introduces an LLM-driven graph-traversal agent to navigate the graph and progressively collect supporting passages.
blocks.zh: (二)KGP(Wang等人,2024年)在多个通道上构建一个知识图,边缘编码其语义和语法相似性;在检索时,引入了LLM驱动的图形传导剂,以导航该图表,并逐步收集辅助通道.

blocks.en: (iii) G-Retriever ( He et al., 2024 ) combines graph neural networks with LLMs by formulating subgraph retrieval as a Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree optimization problem, for conversational question answering on textual graphs while mitigating hallucination and enhancing scalability.
blocks.zh: (三)G-Retriever(He et al., 2024)将图神经网络与LLMs结合,通过将子图检索开发成Prime-Collection Steiner Tree优化问题,用于在文字图上回答对话问题,同时减轻幻觉,增强伸缩性.

blocks.en: (iv) RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) builds a hierarchical tree by applying clustering algorithms and abstractive summarization, facilitating representation at multiple semantic granularities.
blocks.zh: (四) RAPTOR(Sarthi 等人,2024年)通过应用集群算法和抽象的归纳来构建一个分级树,方便在多个语义颗粒上进行代表.

blocks.en: (v) E2GraphRAG ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) uses spaCy to extract entities and LLMs to summarize passage groups into a hierarchical tree with encoded nodes at indexing; at retrieval, it hits relevant entities in their multi-hop neighborhood and collects associated passages for ranking, otherwise performing dense retrieval over the whole tree.
blocks.zh: (五) E2GraphRAG(赵等人,2025年)使用温泉. Cy来提取实体和LLMs,将通道组归纳成一个分级树,在索引时编码节点;在检索时,它会击中其多跳相邻的相关实体并收集相关段落进行排名,否则会在整棵树上进行密集检索.

blocks.en: (vi) LightRAG ( Guo et al., 2025 ) employs a two-tier framework that incorporates graph-based representations within textual indexing, merging fine-grained entity–relation mappings with coarse-grained thematic structures.
blocks.zh: (六) LightRAG(Guo等人,2025年)采用了一种双层框架,将基于图表的表述纳入文字索引,将细纹实体-关系绘图与粗纹主题结构合并。

blocks.en: (vii) HippoRAG ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) is a training-free graph-enhanced retriever that uses the Personalized PageRank algorithm with query concepts as seeds for single-step or multi-hop retrieval across disparate documents.
blocks.zh: (七) HippoRAG(Gutiérrez等人,2024年)是一种训练无图强化检索器,它使用带有查询概念的PageRank个人化算法作为单步或多跳检索的种子,跨越不同的文档.

blocks.en: (viii) GFM-RAG ( Luo et al., 2025 ) implements a GraphRAG paradigm by constructing graphs from documents and using a graph-enhanced retriever to retrieve relevant documents.
blocks.zh: (八) GFM-RAG(Luo等人,2025年)实施GraphRAG范式,从文档中构建图表,并使用增强图表的检索器检索相关文档。

blocks.en: (ix) HippoRAG2 ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) extends HippoRAG with enhanced paragraph integration and contextualization, optimizing seed-node selection and PageRank reset probabilities while maintaining factual-memory capabilities.
blocks.zh: (九) HippoRAG2(Gutiérrez等人,2025年)扩展了HippoRAG,加强了段落集成和背景化,优化了种子节点选择和PageRank重置概率,同时保持了事实模拟能力.

blocks.en: (x) LinearRAG ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) is the direct baseline used for comparison; it performs linear-time retrieval over an entity–sentence–passage tri-graph via Personalized PageRank, without the entity-neighbor modeling introduced in this work.

blocks.en: Appendix I Case Studies: Two Failure Modes of Query-Gated Propagation
blocks.zh: 附录一 案例研究: 两种失败模式的查询 - 传播

blocks.en: We concretize the two failure modes of Section 3.1 with two real multi-hop instances on which NexusRAG answers correctly and LinearRAG does not. In each case the gold reasoning chain is shown as Support Context and the two systems’ retrieved context is compared side by side (Tables 9 and 10 ). Case I.1 illustrates query-gated cutoff in a representative case: LinearRAG never anchors the bridge entity, so the answer-bearing passage is missing from its context entirely. Case I.2 illustrates spurious activation : LinearRAG does complete the first hop, but the bridging sentence names two co-occurring entities and the walk moves to the other co-occurring entity, so the second hop terminates on the wrong branch and the answer passage is again never retrieved. In both cases, NexusRAG recovers a passage that LinearRAG does not return.

blocks.en: I.1 Case 1: Query-Gated Cutoff Drops the Bridge
blocks.zh: I.1 案例1:查询-Gated Cutoff 扔下桥梁

blocks.en: The question asks what is distinctive about a forum addressed by an American poet, memoirist, and civil-rights activist. Its gold reasoning chain is two-hop: the activist resolves to Maya Angelou , who spoke at the Ford Hall Forum , and that forum is defined as the oldest free public lecture series in the United States. The relevant bridge is therefore the entity Ford Hall Forum , whose defining sentence (“the oldest free public lecture series”) is lexically distant from the query’s “American poet, memoirist, and civil rights activist”.
blocks.zh: 一位美国诗人、记忆家和民权活动家, 它的黄金推理链是双跳的:活动家决心向在福特大厅论坛演讲的玛雅·安杰卢(Maya Angelou), 因此,相关的桥梁是实体福特·霍尔论坛,其定义性句子(“最古老的自由公共讲座系列”)与质疑的“美国诗人、记忆家和民权活动家”相距甚远。

blocks.en: LinearRAG answers incorrectly. Its retriever returns several topically adjacent poet / civil-rights passages, including one that mentions Maya Angelou only in passing (the Grosvenor biography), but never surfaces the Ford Hall Forum article that contains the answer sentence. Because the answer-bearing passage is absent from the context, the generator cannot recover it and instead outputs the unrelated “United Nations”. This is an instance of query-gated cutoff (Section 3.1 ): the query-gated propagation fails to carry activation across the weakly query-similar bridge to Ford Hall Forum .
blocks.zh: 线性RAG答错. 包括提到玛雅的一段。 安杰罗只是路过(格罗斯文诺传记),但从未露出福特霍尔论坛中包含答案句的文章. 由于上下文没有包含答案的段落,生成者无法收回,而是输出出无关的“联合国”。 这是查询中断的例子(第3.1节):查询中断的传播未能将激活带过弱的查询-类似桥连接到福特大厅论坛。

blocks.en: NexusRAG answers correctly. In addition to the query-gated sentence-mediated propagation, its neighbor mechanism performs a structural expansion (Eq. 3 ) along pre-computed entity–entity edges that are sentence-independent. This expansion reaches the weakly query-similar bridge Ford Hall Forum before the query-gated propagation removes it from the final context. The case is consistent with the role of structural propagation in preserving a weakly query-similar bridge during subsequent passage ranking. The generator then reads off “the oldest free public lecture series in the United States.” This illustrates the role of the structural propagation in retrieving bridges whose sentences have low query similarity.
blocks.zh: NexusRAG回答正确. 除了以查询方式的句子为媒介的传播之外,它的邻接机制还沿着预先计算的实体-独立句子的实体边缘进行结构扩张(Eq.3)。 这种扩展在查询的传播将它从最后的上下文中移除之前到达了弱的查询-类似桥福特大厅论坛. 这种情况与结构传播在其后的通过排名中维护一个微弱的查询-类似桥的作用是一致的。 生成器随后删除了“美国最古老的免费讲座系列”。 这说明了结构传播在检索其句子低查询性相似的桥梁方面的作用。

blocks.en: I.2 Case 2: Spurious Activation Diverts the Second Hop
blocks.zh: I.2 案例2: 纯洁的动向

blocks.en: The second instance is a 2WikiMultihopQA question on which LinearRAG does complete the first hop and retrieves the bridging passage, yet still fails, even though it names the correct bridge entity in its own output, because the second hop moves to an entity that merely co-occurs with the bridge in the same sentence. The two systems share four of their five retrieved passages; Table 10 compares the two contexts.

LinearRAG retrieves the hop-1 bridging passage (349) and correctly identifies the mother, Infanta Blanca of Spain , but its second-hop expansion follows the father Leopold Salvator , the entity that co-occurs with the mother in that very sentence, and returns his biography (630) instead; the mother’s own article (147), which states her date of birth, is never retrieved, and LinearRAG answers “not mentioned in the text”. NexusRAG returns the same hop-1 passage and retains passage 147, and answers correctly. Passage IDs are the retriever’s own indices; ✓ marks passages that carry a gold fact.
blocks.zh: 表10:案例研究(2Wiki MultiHopQA). LinearRAG取回了hop-1的桥接通道(349),并正确识别了西班牙的Infanta Blanca的母亲,但其第二次扩展遵循了父亲Leopold Salvator,他与母亲在同一句中共同占卜的实体,并退回了他的传记(630);母亲自己的文章(147),其中说明了她的出生日期,但从未被取回,LinearRAG回答“案文中没有提到”。 NexusRAG返回相同的hop-1通道并保留147通道,答案正确. 传球 身份证是检索者自己的指数;

blocks.en: The question is two-hop: Karl Pius resolves to his mother Infanta Blanca of Spain , and her article gives the date of birth. Both hops hinge on a single sentence in passage 349, which states that Karl Pius “was the tenth and youngest child of archduke Leopold Salvator … and infanta Blanca of Spain ”; that is, the sentence names both parents, only one of whom is the mother the query asks for.
blocks.zh: 她的文章给出了出生日期。 两者都取决于第349段的一句话,其中指出卡尔·皮乌斯“是Leopold Salvator大公......和西班牙的Blanca婴儿的第十个孩子和最年幼的孩子”;也就是说,这句话是父母双方的名字,其中只有一个是查询要求的母亲。

blocks.en: LinearRAG answers incorrectly, and its own output shows where the chain breaks. It retrieves passage 349, and its generation explicitly identifies “ Archduke Leopold Salvator (1863–1931), he is the father ” and searches for “Blanca” with a date, so hop-1 succeeded. What it never retrieves is the mother’s own article. Its only passage not shared with NexusRAG is passage 630, the biography of Leopold Salvator : the second-hop expansion followed an entity that shares the bridging sentence rather than the queried one. This is Spurious activation (Section 3.1 ): a query-similar sentence activates every entity it contains, and with no structural prior to tell which co-occurrence realizes the queried relation, the walk assigns higher activation to the wrong parent. Its downstream consequence is a retrieval gap: the answer passage is missing, so the generator can only report that the date is “not mentioned in the text” (it even notes the father’s 15 October 1863 as a tempting but wrong substitute).
blocks.zh: 线性RAG答错,它自己的输出显示链断处. 它取回了349号通道,其一代明确确认 " 利奥波德·萨尔瓦托尔大公(1863年–1931年),他是父亲 " ,并用日期搜索 " 布兰卡 " ,因此成功跳到1号。 从未找到的是母亲自己的文章。 它唯一没有与NexusRAG共享的段落是第630段,这是Leopold Salvator的传记:第二波扩展是跟随一个实体分享连接句而不是被询问的句子。 这是纯粹激活(第3.1节):一个查询-类似句子会激活它包含的每一个实体,在告诉哪个共发生实现被询问关系之前,没有结构,行走会给错误的家长分配更高的激活. 它的下游后果是检索漏洞:答案段落缺失,因此生成者只能报告日期"在文本中未提及"(它甚至注意到父亲1863年10月15日是诱人但错误的替代).

blocks.en: NexusRAG answers correctly, and the decisive element is the semantic propagation’s neighbor clamp (Eq. 2 , Section 3 ). A transition from an activated entity is admitted only up to the weight of the pre-computed neighbor edge, so an entity that merely shares the bridging sentence is capped rather than freely inherited. Leopold Salvator (the father) is not in the neighbor set of Karl Pius at the adopted setting (top- κ = 5 \kappa{=}5 ; Table 7 ), so the sentence-mediated path propagating through the shared sentence of passage 349 assigns him the lower bound δ \delta instead of the full transition score; his biography (passage 630) therefore does not enter the top-5 through this transition. Because the mother’s article (147), which carries the date of birth, already sits at the edge of the dense retriever’s ranking, it is retained once the incidental father is no longer amplified, and the generator reads off “7 September 1868”. The retrieval difference is consistent with the lower activation assigned to the incidental father under the structural propagation.
blocks.zh: NexusRAG回答正确,决定性的因素是语义传播的邻居夹子(Eq.2,第3节)。 从一个激活的实体的过渡只被允许到预先计算出的邻居边缘的重量,因此一个仅仅共享连接句的实体被封顶而不是自由继承. 利奥波德·萨尔瓦托(英语:Leopold Salvator (the father))在被采纳的设定中并不在卡尔·皮乌斯的邻居组合中(top-ob = 5\kappa{=}5;表7),因此通过第349段的共用句子传播的句子的句子将他指定为下界的\\delta而不是完整的过渡分数;因此他的传记(630通道)没有通过这一过渡进入上界-5. 由于母亲的文章(147)载有出生日期,已经坐落在密集的检索者排名的边缘,一旦偶然的父亲不再被放大,生成者就会被保留下来,并读出 " 1868年9月7日 " 。 检索差异与结构传播下分配给偶然父亲的较低激活率一致。

blocks.en: The measurements show that the additional cost is concentrated in preprocessing. The one-time Precompute(s) for NexusRAG ranges from about 2 2 s on Medical to roughly 25 25 s on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, while LinearRAG has no neighbor stage. The base Index(s) differs by only a few percent between the two methods, consistent with their shared graph index construction. Retrieval(s) differs by a few percent on three benchmarks and by about 6% on MuSiQue (e.g., 0.260 0.260 s vs 0.252 0.252 s on HotpotQA, 0.216 0.216 s vs 0.216 0.216 s on Medical). The structural propagation reuses the cached neighbor matrix and adds a vectorized step. The reported results therefore add a one-time preprocessing stage without changing the basic online retrieval procedure.

blocks.en: Observation 9. On ATLAS-Wiki, the neighbor precompute costs 106.93 106.93 s at 5M tokens and 228.87 228.87 s at 10M, i.e., 2.6 % 2.6\% and 2.8 % 2.8\% of NexusRAG’s total indexing cost, so the one-time overhead of the structural propagation stays below 3 % 3\% at both scales.
